---
domain: personal knowledge management
# The vocabulary this vault declares for itself. All six dimensions are declared, and every
# note conforms to all six: this is the negative control for ZK003, the check that reads
# them. A vacuously conforming vault — one that declares one dimension and leaves five
# unchecked — would prove nothing about the five.
tags: [cognition, knowledge-management, memory, method]
required_fields: [id, title, type, status, created, updated, confidence, tags, sources]
types: [permanent]
statuses: [evergreen, seed]
confidences: [high, medium]
verbs: [applies, contradicts, extends, source, supersedes, supports]
---

# Schema

This vault is about how notes compound: atomic ideas, dense links, provable provenance.
